bill_correction.description: At least one manual amount/action pair or one player-driven correction (added_players / removed_bill_players) must be present, otherwise the request is rejected with a without_any_correction error. fiat_amount/coin_amount may be left blank (or sent as 0) *only* when the request also carries at least one player-driven correction — otherwise a blank/zero amount is a validation error on that currency.

fiat_amount.description: Manual fiat amount for this correction. Must be paired with fiat_action. Ignored/optional when added_players or removed_bill_players is present and this is left blank or "0".

fiat_action.description: "add" to add money or "subtract" to remove. Required whenever fiat_amount is a positive value.

coin_amount.description: Same rules as fiat_amount, for the bill's coin currency.

coin_action.description: "add" to add coins or "subtract" to remove. Required whenever coin_amount is a positive value.

scope.description: Comment scope. Available values: operator, partner

added_players.description: Players to manually add to this bill, as returned by GET .../player_qualifications/player_suggestions: not qualified, or qualified but removed from a bill and not counted by any bill anymore (the latest qualification on each bill is "removed"). For each entry a new PlayerQualification (kind: "added") is created and a not qualified player becomes qualified immediately. reward_currency/reward_amount must be one of the combinations returned by GET .../player_qualifications/reward_options for this bill.

reward_amount.description: CPA reward amount for this player in major units, e.g. "100.00"

removed_bill_players.description: Existing, already-qualified players to remove from this bill. "player_qualification_id" is the PlayerQualification#id (from the Player qualifications list or suggestions) — not the player_id. The matching PlayerQualification row is updated in place (kind: "removed"), never deleted; returning the player later via added_players creates a new one.

qualified.description: Defaults to true if omitted. true: player stays permanently excluded from re-qualification (abuse case). false: player becomes eligible for auto-qualification again on a future bill. Must be false for a player originally added to the bill manually ("initially_manual" in the player qualifications list).
